world_height_definition: Kerf CU proposed person at the cut; kept (Halyard BD, 2026-11-08). A person (the Warden) = 1.0. The new idle is 291px tall where the old was 188px; the battle draws every idle at one person's height, so he stands as tall on the board as before.
source: Lakshmana Archer Pixel Art Sprite Sheet.png (cursor-lakshmana-recut, Kerf CU)
note: Nothing in web/combat reads size_class or world_height yet.
minimum_pixel_size_definition: The draw height the person class must reach on screen (ROLES.md Art sizing). The idle's source alpha height is above it.
foot_point_definition: The idle's foot point in idle.png's pixels: centre x of the bottom alpha row, and that row.
